[Pattapiṇḍika+sutta]  CL=8 a sutta discussing the five types of people who practice Pattapindika-dhutanga (the ascetic practice of using only one bowl):
1. One who practices due to being foolish and slow-witted
2. One who practices with evil desires and afflictions
3. One who practices due to mental derangement
4. One who practices because it was praised by the Buddha and his disciples
5. One who practices based on having few desires and being content
The sutta explains that among these five types, the fifth type - one who practices out of genuine contentment and having few desires - is considered the noblest and most excellent
